excerpts:
Five CFP ranked teams lost to unranked opponents, including two top 10 teams: No. 4 UCLA, No. 8 Indiana.  
  
**No. 1 Georgia 34, No. 21 South Carolina 6**  
Georgia clinched a spot in the SEC Championship Game on Saturday night.  
  
South Carolina led 6-3 early and gained 100 yards in the first quarter, but Georgia's defense held the Gamecocks to 118 yards the rest of the way. Nate Frazier ran for two touchdowns, Khalil Barnes intercepted LaNorris Sellers inside the Georgia 20, and the Bulldogs sacked Sellers three times. Georgia outgained South Carolina 421-218.  
  
It was Georgia's fifth straight win over South Carolina. The Bulldogs (10-1, 8-1 SEC) close the regular season against Georgia Tech, while South Carolina falls to 6-5 after back-to-back losses.
